07c528e594cb3b34.fallbackQualification: One process, serial Texture.GenerateBitmap(depth0,face0,mip,TextureCodec.None=0). Native BGRA storage reorders to RGBA only. Unpremultiplied channel bytes retained; no gamma, flip, normal reconstruction, resample or generated mips. Source srgb is retained separately as sampling metadata; byte values are not linearized. Accepted formats BC7,BC1(no-alpha per pinned decoder),RGBA8888,BC5(native RG with no Z reconstruction). No HDR input present.
